test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. **

One who can use both hands equally well.
solution: The correct answer is **''Ambidextrous"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points __** • Let's see the meaning of other words. • **Multitalented** :_Having many skills or talents. एक व्यक्ति के अंदर एक से ज्यादा कुशलताये और प्रतिभा होना • **Multifaceted** :- Having Many Sides बहुमुखी • **Ambidextrous** :-One who can use both hands equally well दाएं और बाएं हाथ का समान रूप से उपयोग करने में सक्षम। • **Ambivalent** :- having mixed feelings or contradictory ideas about something or someone. किसी चीज़ या किसी के बारे में मिश्रित भावनाएँ या विरोधाभासी विचार होना • The correct word as the group of words given will be **"Ambidextrous"** 35:T6f0, The Correct Answer is "**was enjoyed"** which contains a grammatical error.
